games.name: Undead Defense
games.desc:
Undead Defense is a teamwork based zombie survival game where players are divided into two teams: humans and zombies.
The goal is simple: humans must survive until the end of the 6 waves, while zombies try to infect all the humans.

As a Human: 👤
Find a safe spot, build barricades, cooperate, fight off zombies, and upgrade

As a Zombie: 🧟
Attack humans, coordinate with other zombies, and don’t give up: Even if you die, you’ll respawn and keep attacking until all humans are infected or until the wave has ended.

[PC Controls] 💻
E - Grab prop
RMB (Right mouse button) - Use zombie ability / Nail prop
Q - Zombie type selection menu / Rotate prop
T - Tilt prop
B - Shop
O - Cosmetic Shop
I - Cosmetic Inventory
F - Flashlight
Z - Emotes
CTRL - Crouch

[Console Controls] 🎮
X - Grab prop / Use zombie ability / Nail prop 
Up on DPad - Flashlight
Down on DPad - Emotes
L2 - Tilt Prop
R2 - Rotate prop
